data.narrative:
Union is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $51.3M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 10 peers spanning 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses the $51.3M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $128M. Peer-Median triangulates across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—producing a median of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B. The Stage-Progression method anchors toward the lower bound given Union's nascent stage and limited operating history; the Peer-Median reflects the sector's capital intensity and growth multiples but introduces volatility given the wide peer dispersion.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $109M to $460M, with a median of $264M. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the peer set's stage distribution—two comparables are Series A while Union remains Seed—and UFORCE's outsized $1.0B valuation, which materially skews the peer median upward. Revenue traction and product differentiation would be critical to positioning within this range.
